summary: First Phosphate Corp. filed a Form 6-K with an attached press release announcing that its board and management will ring the Nasdaq Opening Bell on August 13, 2026, to celebrate the company's recent listing on the Nasdaq Global Market. The release highlights the company's goals in building a North American lithium iron phosphate battery supply chain. No financial terms, transactions, or special-situation events are disclosed. The filing is promotional in nature and does not constitute an acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation.
